dedupe_keys.name: china city level emissions and socioeconomic inventory 2010

description: The Figshare collection combines city-level energy use, emissions and socioeconomic indicators for China in 2010. Its three child items separate the energy inventory, emissions inventory and socioeconomic inventory, allowing a modeller to relate urban energy demand to emissions and population or economic context. It can support calibration of city-scale energy scenarios or comparison of a simulated decarbonisation pathway against an observed historical baseline. The data are an inventory, not measurements of each power plant or utility network. City boundaries, sector definitions and the single baseline year must be kept consistent when joining it to newer inputs. All 3 member item(s) state CC0 in the Figshare article API; the collection DataCite registration says CC BY 4.0. I read the descriptor and Figshare metadata without opening the tables or checking their internal completeness. The comparison collections had no exact resource identity or explicit parent coverage. A caveat is that city inventory methods may vary from those used in the related national and provincial China CO2 accounts; the two G1 drafts should be compared before joining them.
